news.title: Info Edge Q1 Results: Standalone Profit falls 6% YoY to Rs 245 crore

news.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 10 August: Hitachi Energy, Paytm, Titian, BSE, BEML, Lenskart among top gainers
news.summary: On August 10, the Indian stock market traded within a narrow range amid Middle East tensions affecting oil prices. Nifty 50 saw a slight increase of 0.05%, while Sensex dipped 0.06%. Sector performance varied, with heavy selling in some indices and gains in Realty and Private Bank stocks.
